 Filipino MSMEs account for 66% of Shopee’s 11.11 orders 
 By Back End News 
 Nov 20, 2026 
 Filipino micro, small, and medium enterprises (MSMEs) accounted for 66% of all orders on Shopee in the Philippines during its 11.11 Mega Pamasko Sale. Orders for these sellers were 119% higher than on an average day, Shopee said.
 More shoppers also bought products after watching videos on the platform. Shopee said checkouts through Shopee Video increased 30% from a year earlier. The feature gives shoppers a way to see how a product works and ask the seller questions in the comments before placing an order.
 Shopee fulfillment orders jump 2.5x during 9.9 sale 
 “Holiday shopping in the Philippines is becoming far more visual, deliberate, and value-driven,” said Vincent Lee, head of Shopee Philippines. “Shoppers want to stretch their budgets through programs like ShopeeVIP while seeing products in action via Shopee Video. And Filipino MSMEs have been quick to meet that demand. Our role is to keep lowering the barriers so local sellers can turn that engagement into sustainable growth through 11.11 and beyond.”
 Shopee said members of its ShopeeVIP program were among the first to place orders when the sale opened. Members get daily vouchers for 20% off, shipping discounts, and priority customer service. ShopeeVIP+ also includes access to Netflix and YouTube Premium Lite.
